title: Gated Recurrent Neural Tensor Network
question: How much improvement do the introduced model achieve compared to the previous models?
correct_answer: Two settings on PTB. Character-level: GRURNTN reduced BPC from 1.39 to 1.33 (0.06 absolute / 4.32% relative) over GRURNN; LSTMRNTN from 1.37 to 1.34 (0.03 / 2.22%) over LSTMRNN. Word-level: GRURNTN reduced perplexity from 97.78 to 87.38 (10.4 absolute / 10.63% relative) over GRURNN; LSTMRNTN from 108.26 to 96.97 (11.29 / 10.42%) over LSTMRNN.

evidence.quote: GRURNTN reduced the BPC from 1.39 to 1.33 (0.06 absolute / 4.32% relative BPC) from the baseline GRURNN, and LSTMRNTN reduced the BPC from 1.37 to 1.34 (0.03 absolute / 2.22% relative BPC)

GRURNTN reduced the perplexity from 97.78 to 87.38 (10.4 absolute / 10.63% relative PPL) over the baseline GRURNN and LSTMRNTN reduced the perplexity from 108.26 to 96.97 (11.29 absolute / 10.42% relative PPL)
